## `client.users`

{class}`~plone_client.managers.users.UsersManager`.

Site users (`@users`).

### `client.users.list`

Users of the site.

See {meth}`~plone_client.managers.users.UsersManager.list`.

Calls `GET /@users` ([`plone.restapi` documentation](https://6.docs.plone.org/plone.restapi/docs/source/endpoints/users.html)).

`````{tab-set}
:sync-group: service-example

````{tab-item} Python
:sync: python

```python
client.users.list(search="jo")
```
````

````{tab-item} Command line
:sync: cli

```shell
plone-client users list -q jo -f id,fullname
```

```json
[
  {
    "id": "jdoe",
    "fullname": "Jo Doe"
  }
]
```
````

````{tab-item} HTTP
:sync: http

```http
GET /Plone/++api++/@users?search=jo HTTP/1.1
Host: localhost:8080
Accept: application/json
Authorization: Basic YWRtaW46YWRtaW4=
```

```shell
curl -i -X GET 'http://localhost:8080/Plone/++api++/@users?search=jo' -H 'accept: application/json' -u admin:admin
```
````
`````

```json
[
  {
    "fullname": "Jo Doe",
    "id": "jdoe"
  }
]
```

This shows only `id`, `fullname` of each entry.

### `client.users.update_password`

Set a new password.

See {meth}`~plone_client.managers.users.UsersManager.update_password`.

`jdoe_client` is a client logged in as `jdoe`: the site refuses this request from anyone else, a Manager included, and without `old_password`.

Calls `POST /@users/jdoe/reset-password` ([`plone.restapi` documentation](https://6.docs.plone.org/plone.restapi/docs/source/endpoints/users.html)).

`````{tab-set}
:sync-group: service-example

````{tab-item} Python
:sync: python

```python
jdoe_client.users.update_password(
    "jdoe",
    "another-long-password",
    old_password="correct-horse-battery",
)
```
````

````{tab-item} HTTP
:sync: http

```http
POST /Plone/++api++/@users/jdoe/reset-password HTTP/1.1
Host: localhost:8080
Accept: application/json
Content-Type: application/json
Authorization: Basic amRvZTpjb3JyZWN0LWhvcnNlLWJhdHRlcnk=

{
  "new_password": "another-long-password",
  "old_password": "correct-horse-battery"
}
```

```shell
curl -i -X POST http://localhost:8080/Plone/++api++/@users/jdoe/reset-password -H 'accept: application/json' -H 'content-type: application/json' -u admin:admin --data-raw '{"new_password":"another-long-password","old_password":"correct-horse-battery"}'
```
````
`````

The site answers `200`, and the method returns `None`.

### `client.sharing.principals`

Users and groups matching a text (`@principals`).

See {meth}`~plone_client.managers.users.SharingManager.principals`.

Calls `GET /@principals` ([`plone.restapi` documentation](https://6.docs.plone.org/plone.restapi/docs/source/endpoints/principals.html)).

`````{tab-set}
:sync-group: service-example

````{tab-item} Python
:sync: python

```python
client.sharing.principals("jdoe")
```
````

````{tab-item} HTTP
:sync: http

```http
GET /Plone/++api++/@principals?search=jdoe HTTP/1.1
Host: localhost:8080
Accept: application/json
Authorization: Basic YWRtaW46YWRtaW4=
```

```shell
curl -i -X GET 'http://localhost:8080/Plone/++api++/@principals?search=jdoe' -H 'accept: application/json' -u admin:admin
```
````
`````

```json
{
  "users": [
    {
      "fullname": "Jo Doe",
      "id": "jdoe"
    }
  ]
}
```

This shows only `users`. This shows only `id`, `fullname` of each entry.

### `client.sharing.roles`

Roles defined on the site (`@roles`).

See {meth}`~plone_client.managers.users.SharingManager.roles`.

Calls `GET /@roles` ([`plone.restapi` documentation](https://6.docs.plone.org/plone.restapi/docs/source/endpoints/roles.html)).

`````{tab-set}
:sync-group: service-example

````{tab-item} Python
:sync: python

```python
client.sharing.roles()
```
````

````{tab-item} HTTP
:sync: http

```http
GET /Plone/++api++/@roles HTTP/1.1
Host: localhost:8080
Accept: application/json
Authorization: Basic YWRtaW46YWRtaW4=
```

```shell
curl -i -X GET http://localhost:8080/Plone/++api++/@roles -H 'accept: application/json' -u admin:admin
```
````
`````

```json
[
  {
    "id": "Contributor",
    "title": "Contributor"
  },
  {
    "id": "Editor",
    "title": "Editor"
  },
  {
    "id": "Member",
    "title": "Member"
  }
]
```

This shows only `id`, `title` of each entry. This shows 3 of 7 entries.
